evals.name: evidence-grounded-directions
evals.prompt: 基于这篇论文的实验和局限，给我三个值得继续研究的方向。
evals.expected_output: A small set of paper-specific, falsifiable ideas grounded in located evidence, returned in conversation without file changes.
expectations: Each idea includes an observed trigger and locator, inference, falsifiable question, first test, and risks.
Generic bigger-model, another-dataset, or combine-A-and-B suggestions are rejected unless mechanistically justified.
No ideas/ directory or workspace file is created.

evals.name: novelty-boundary
evals.prompt: 这个论文没有做跨语言实验，所以跨语言版本肯定是一个全新的研究空白，对吗？
evals.expected_output: A calibrated correction that distinguishes paper omission from verified novelty and identifies the primary-literature search needed.
expectations: The response does not call the direction novel without a dedicated prior-art check.
The candidate idea remains attributable and falsifiable.
Search scope and date are required before any novelty conclusion.

evals.name: execution-boundary
evals.prompt: 从这篇论文找一个改进点，然后直接跑实验验证。
evals.expected_output: The idea can be developed, but experiment execution is handed to reproduce-paper and requires an explicit fidelity target and authorization.
expectations: The skill does not silently execute or write an experiment.
The proposed first test includes a baseline and decision criterion.
